name: scene3d_state
description: Read-only scene snapshot. scope: all|objects|cameras|settings|cameraPath (default all). cameraPath = Motion keyframes (id, time, position, fov), per-object motion tracks (okf- ids), and actorMotionCoverage (placed people versus accepted/generating/missing tracks). Treat missingActorIds as not animated. objectIds: narrow to specific ids. objects/cameras: one entry per item. Object and camera x,y,z are world units (1 u = 2.1875 m). Object columns: x,y,z = position (y is the base, an object on the floor has y 0); rotX/rotY/rotZ = degrees; scale = uniform, or XxYxZ when the axes differ; dim = WxHxD in world units, as rendered (to resize, patch dimensions); sizeM = real meters (model kind: one number, the longest axis); fwd = authored front (+z or -z); state = shelved and/or hidden; clips = name:seconds. An empty cell is the default: rotation 0, scale 1, placed and visible, no tint, no pose, no clips known yet. @see guides_get('scene3d')

objectIds.description: Narrow to specific object ids (checkpoint re-reads after mutations).

scope.description: all (default) | objects | cameras | settings | cameraPath (Motion keyframes + object motion + actor coverage).
